stories.headline: Microsoft releases Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4-billion parameter vision-language model
stories.summary: Microsoft announced a new vision-language model called Mage-VL-Cowork with 4 billion parameters. The model is designed for hybrid computer tasks and uses a specialized training curriculum to achieve strong performance.
stories.whyItMatters: It expands the availability of compact multimodal models that can handle both visual and textual inputs for productivity tasks.

stories.headline: Barclays expands use of Anthropic's Claude across global operations
stories.summary: Barclays is integrating Anthropic's Claude AI assistant into its worldwide operations to speed up software development and modernize legacy systems. The bank aims for half of its developers to use Claude Code by the end of 2026 to boost efficiency and improve customer experience.
stories.whyItMatters: The deployment shows a major financial institution adopting generative AI to transform its development processes.
